verdict.rationale: Stable documents opening and scanning mail contents, not just envelopes ('free high-res scans of internal mail contents'). The MailItem object carries scanDetails with a processing/completed status and ocrResultUrls, which points to OCR'd, searchable output. Nothing in the evidence states a scan turnaround time, and the output is never described as searchable PDF. Missing for 10: a stated same- or next-business-day scan SLA, explicit searchable-PDF output format, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scan quality and timing.
